title: Enum and pipelines
hints: Start each function with the data and pipe it: numbers |> Enum.filter(...) |> Enum.map(...) |> Enum.sum()
String.split() with no second argument splits on any whitespace. Enum.frequencies counts for you.
Sort by a tuple to break ties: Enum.sort_by(fn {word, count} -> {-count, word} end)
